fields.summary_ko.0: TXN recorded a +89.2% return over 5 years from November 2021 to November 2026, while total revenue increased 18.1% over the same period, yet EPS declined -1.0%.
fields.summary_ko.1: In contrast, NXPI rose +34.5% over the same period with 31.0% total revenue growth and +124.7% EPS increase, though the P/E ratio investors pay declined from 33.1x (2021) to 20.9x (current).
fields.summary_ko.2: The return differential between TXN and NXPI derives more from valuation (P/E) changes than differences in sales growth.
